criteria.requirement: Add Token.deep_copy() for actual token graphs, isolating nested children/image-alt tokens, attrs, map and supported arbitrary meta while preserving shared aliases and cycles within the copied graph. Original Token.copy(**changes) remains shallow. Standard deepcopy-compatible custom values participate normally; uncopyable opaque meta raises its original failure and must never be silently shared or partially mutate the original. Demonstrate independent rendered document edits and self-referential metadata, not serialization that drops types or cycle relationships.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
